headline: Evercore ISI Group Maintains Outperform on Welltower, Raises Price Target to $260
summary: Evercore ISI Group  analyst Steve Sakwa   maintains Welltower (NYSE:WELL) with a Outperform and raises the price target from $236 to $260.
